title: Studio Crossing at Quinn's Junction
description:
Studio Crossing at Quinn's Junction is a premier Class A mixed-use commercial development located at the eastern gateway to Park City.
Offering approximately 300,000 square feet of retail, restaurant, medical, and professional office space, the project is designed to serve one of Summit County's fastest-growing communities. Positioned directly across from Intermountain Health Park City Hospital, Studio Crossing offers exceptional visibility, easy access to Highway 40 and I-80, and is less than 10 minutes from Historic Main Street. Modern architecture, flexible floor plans, abundant parking, and a growing residential population make Studio Crossing an ideal location for businesses looking to establish or expand their presence in Park City.

title: Quarry Village
description: Quarry Village is a neighborhood shopping center strategically located in the heart of Pinebrook. It is one of Park City's most established and desirable communities. Offering convenient access from Interstate 80, Gorgoza Pines Road, Kilby Road, and Pinebrook Boulevard, the center serves both local residents and commuters traveling between Salt Lake City and Park City. Surrounded by affluent residential neighborhoods, schools, and recreational destinations, Quarry Village provides excellent visibility, strong co-tenancy, and a loyal customer base.
